PLAN "3-Week Reconditioning Block - Return to Strength"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Return to baseline strength after illness"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Reconditioning - upper focus":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Reconditioning - lower focus":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 40m "Reconditioning - full body light":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          db_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          overhead_shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progressive load - upper":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Progressive load - lower":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full body maturational":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 2 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Return to baseline - heavy-ish":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          squat 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          deadlift 3x4..6 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_deck 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Hypertrophy maintenance":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 60m "Conditioning & mobility":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 3 minutes

goals.name: Return to baseline strength after illness
